Diziyou Film Merkezi adapter

This is an independent community adapter written for the Film Merkezi plugin API.
It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Diziyou or Film Merkezi.

The adapter contains original integration code and protocol/markup compatibility
logic based on the user-provided Diziyou provider reference. Website content,
logos, video files, subtitles, and other third-party materials remain the property
of their respective rights holders. This adapter does not grant access rights or
licenses to third-party content.

Use only where you have the right to access the target service and its content.
